title: Vancouver City Sightseeing Experience by Private Limousine
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See the best of Vancouver in comfort, on your own private tour by chauffeured limousine. Over about four hours, your chauffeur drives you to the city's most photogenic spots and points out the landmarks along the way while you sit back and enjoy the ride. It's your vehicle and your pace, with time to step out, look around, and take photos at every stop.

You'll roll through the cobblestone streets of Gastown, into Stanley Park with its seawall and ocean views, along the beaches of English Bay, over to the Granville Island Public Market, and up to Queen Elizabeth Park for one of the best skyline views in the city. Your chauffeur knows Vancouver well and is happy to share tips and recommendations as you go.

Pickup is complimentary anywhere in Vancouver, whether that's your hotel, a private residence, the cruise terminal, or the airport. Bottled water is on board, and the whole tour is private, just your group.
